boxes.observation: Three uppercase letterhead lines; UNIVERSITE is letter-spaced. DU and LANGUEDOC are separated by a wider space. A distinct fourth keyed row has thirteen circumflex marks. No accents supplied to the uppercase text.
Typed place and date, Montpellier, le 14 octobre 1983; no final stop visible.
Two reference lines: Diffusion : Liste A; MA/gs and N° 4375. MA uppercase, gs lowercase. The small raised circle after N is preserved.
Uppercase title; apostrophe in D'UNE; THESE unaccented; lowercase e in 3e is on the baseline.
Uppercase disciplinary title followed by a distinct keyed row of fifty-six equals signs. The row is transcribed as literal repeated glyphs.

Two lines. The field label from Date through prévus is underlined. Date,-heure has a visible comma and hyphen. A much paler short horizontal trace occurs between lieu and de. The date line ends with a comma. The second line has n° 9 and a spaced hyphen.
uncertainties: The short pale trace between lieu and de may be a faint keyed hyphen or a surface trace; retained as \unsure{-}.

boxes.observation: Underlined field label ending thèse, followed by colon and 3 ans. No final stop visible.

Handwritten signature represented by full manually traced TikZ paths. Main large G-shaped loop continues through an inner loop into a long rising terminal and descending stroke. Separate left vertical, lower horizontal flourish with a left fork and adjoining hook, upper-left hook, two detached short dark strokes and one detached dark dot. Faded interruptions in the loop, vertical and lower flourish are retained as separate path portions.
uncertainties: No reliable full letter sequence is extracted from the signature; the visible shape is preserved instead.
Very faint grey marks adjacent to the upper dash and below the descending terminal lack comparable dark ink and are not encoded as definite pen marks.
The lower flourish has a left fork resembling an arrowhead; its form is traced directly without assigning a connector interpretation.

boxes.observation: Isolated handwritten numeral 5. Upper horizontal stroke curves slightly upward to the right; middle bar and lower return are clear.
